sloka: न्यपतत् पतितैः पूर्वम् समरस्थो निशाचरः ।हत शेषाः ततो भग्ना राक्षसाः खर संश्रयाः ॥३-२७-१९॥
transliteration: nyapatat patitaiḥ pūrvam samarastho niśācaraḥ ।hata śeṣāḥ tato bhagnā rākṣasāḥ khara saṁśrayāḥ ॥3-27-19॥

translations.english: Those surviving demons who were under the protection of Khara got scared and retreated fast and fled like deer frightened by a tiger.
